western-sahara-receipts.receipt-1:
Adoption: Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted with 12 votes in favour, zero against, two abstentions (Mozambique, Russian Federation), and one member not participating (Algeria) [MAIN].

Amendments: Algeria's S/2024/797 received 6–0–9; S/2024/798 received 5–0–10; neither adopted [AMEND].

Algeria: Bendjama cited the ninth consecutive year without an OHCHR visit and argued for MINURSO monitoring; he later stated the penholder disregarded Algeria's views and reaffirmed the Sahrawi people's right to choose their future [DZ-A][DZ-B].

Switzerland: No national amendment votes or statements were received [AMEND].

Authority: Mandate extended to 31 October 2025; OHCHR cooperation urged but monitoring functions not added [TEXT].
western-sahara-receipts.receipt-2:
Adoption: Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted with 12 votes in favour, zero against, two abstentions (Mozambique, Russian Federation), and one member not participating (Algeria) [MAIN].

Amendments: Amendment S/2024/797 received 6–0–9; Amendment S/2024/798 received 5–0–10; neither adopted [AMEND].

Algeria: Algeria did not participate in the vote; no national statement on monitoring was received [MAIN].

Switzerland: Switzerland supported S/2024/797 (6–0–9) and abstained on S/2024/798 (5–0–10); Baeriswyl stated the abstention ensured MINURSO continuity [CH-A].

Authority: Mandate extended to 31 October 2025; OHCHR access language included; proposed monitoring functions not added [TEXT].
western-sahara-receipts.receipt-3:
Adoption: Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted with 12 votes in favour, zero against, two abstentions (Mozambique, Russian Federation), and one member not participating (Algeria) [MAIN].

Amendments: Algeria's S/2024/797 received 6–0–9; S/2024/798 received 5–0–10; neither adopted [AMEND].

Algeria: Bendjama cited the ninth consecutive year without an OHCHR visit and argued for MINURSO monitoring; he later explained non-participation as a result of the penholder disregarding Algeria's views [DZ-A][DZ-B].

Switzerland: Baeriswyl supported S/2024/797 (6–0–9) and abstained on S/2024/798 (5–0–10) to ensure MINURSO continuity; she later resumed Council President functions [CH-A][CH-B].

Authority: Mandate extended to 31 October 2025; OHCHR cooperation urged but monitoring functions not added [TEXT].
